title: Eyes on the Image: Gaze Supervised Multimodal Learning for Chest X-ray Diagnosis and Report Generation
abstract: arXiv:2508.13068v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Medical vision-language models still struggle to match radiologists' attention and to verbalize findings with explicit spatial grounding. We address this gap with a two-stage multimodal framework for chest X-ray interpretation built on the MIMIC-Eye dataset. In the first stage introduces a gaze-token classifier that fuses image patches, bounding-box masks, transcription embeddings, and radiologist fixations. A curriculum-scheduled, trust-calibrated composite loss supervises the gaze token, boosting both accuracy and spatial alignment. Adding fixation supervision raises AUC 4.4% and F1 13.3%, and Pearson correlation rises to 0.306, confirming clinically relevant focus. In stage 2, classifier predictions are translated into region-specific diagnostic sentences. translated_title: 凝视图像：基于目光监督的多模态学习用于胸部X射线诊断与报告生成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2508.13068v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：医学视觉语言模型仍难以匹配放射科医生的注意力，也难以用明确的空间定位来表述发现。我们通过一个基于MIMIC-Eye数据集的两阶段多模态框架来解决这一差距。第一阶段引入了一个凝视令牌分类器，融合了图像补丁、边界框掩码、转录嵌入和放射科医生注视点。一个课程调度、信任校准的复合损失函数监督凝视令牌，提高了准确性和空间对齐。添加注视点监督使AUC提高4.4%，F1提高13.3%，皮尔逊相关系数升至0.306，确认了临床相关的关注焦点。在第二阶段，分类器预测被转化为区域特定的诊断语句。提取置信度加权的关键词，通过专家词典映射到17个胸部区域，并用提示式大语言模型进行扩展，增强了临床实用性。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于目光监督的两阶段多模态框架，通过融合放射科医生的注视数据来提升胸部X射线诊断的准确性和空间对齐，并生成区域特定的诊断报告。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a gaze-supervised two-stage multimodal framework that integrates radiologists' fixation data to improve chest X-ray diagnostic accuracy and spatial alignment, generating region-specific diagnostic reports.
